company.name: Roadrunner
company.shortDescription: Roadrunner is developing an AI-native quote-to-cash platform designed to help sales teams structure, price, and close complex deals faster.
company.description: Roadrunner creates software using artificial intelligence for revenue operations and quote-to-cash procedures. Product setup, pricing, quotation generation, contract workflows, and approval management are all supported by the company's platform. Its software organizes sales data, standardizes business procedures, and automates repetitive administrative chores by integrating with current enterprise systems. Organizations utilize the platform to maintain correct revenue-related information across corporate functions, enhance operational consistency, and manage complex sales transactions.
